topic: Shanks let Blackbeard walk away from Marineford instead of finishing him
title: Shanks Let Blackbeard Walk Away From Marineford
description: Shanks had Marshall D. Teach standing right in front of him at Marineford and chose not to fight him. Here's why that wasn't mercy toward Blackbeard, it was priority. Do you think Shanks could have won that fight on the spot?
comment: Was letting Blackbeard walk away smart positioning, or did Shanks just dodge a fight he could have won? Pick one.
